blurb: Bella Ballerina offers dance classes for children that combine imagination, movement, and fun, structured around storybook and fairy tale themes. Classes include ballet, hip-hop, and Broadway-style, designed to be age-appropriate and engaging. The studio emphasizes a positive, fun, and safe environment to build confidence and a love of dance.
